hook.name: LumoriaHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for Lumoria token/BNB pools on BNB Chain that collects platform fees and per-token buy/sell taxes on every swap via BeforeSwapDelta and afterSwapDelta, gates pool initialization and liquidity additions to the LumoriaLiquidityVault, and permanently locks all liquidity (remove liquidity always reverts).
